feed.title: A Box of Tools
feed.subtitle: Free browser tools that never upload your files. Combine images into a PDF or an MP4, compress an image to an exact size, crop a video, or strip EXIF data.

entry.title: How to arrange multiple images into one picture
entry.summary: Make a collage, contact sheet or image strip: choose a grid, keep pictures whole or crop to fill, set the spacing and save a PNG, JPEG or WebP without uploading.

entry.title: How to stack photographs to reduce noise, or remove people
entry.summary: Stacking combines a burst of frames into one picture. Which method to use depends on what you are trying to lose: noise, passers-by, or the shallow depth of field on a macro shot. How each one works, what it costs, and how RAW files fit in.

entry.title: Image Layout
entry.summary: Arrange images in a grid or strip with ready-to-use presets. Adjust each picture with pan and zoom, then save one PNG, JPEG or WebP. Free, offline and no upload.

entry.title: Image Stacker
entry.summary: Combine a burst of photographs into one: average them to kill noise, take the median to remove people from a scene, lighten for star trails, or focus stack a macro shot. Reads CR2, NEF, ARW, DNG, RAF and CR3 by pulling out the camera's own preview. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Share Text & Files
entry.summary: Send text or files from one browser to another over a direct encrypted connection. A speakable link name, live updates as you type, approval for each reader - and nothing stored on any server, ever. Free, no sign-up.

entry.title: Extract receipt and invoice details from photos
entry.summary: How to check receipt OCR and crops, choose one email currency and manual or historical rates, then email compressed images with each converted value, the document count and a grand total.

entry.title: How to share text and files between devices without uploading them
entry.summary: Move text or files from one browser to another over a direct encrypted connection - no email-to-self, no chat history, no account, and nothing stored on any server to delete later.

entry.title: Receipt & Invoice Extractor
entry.summary: Read receipt and invoice photos locally, review crops and amounts, then convert each document into one email currency using manual or historical online rates. Email compressed images, individual values and a grand total.

entry.title: Business Profile Preview
entry.summary: See how your Google Business Profile will look before it goes live: the knowledge panel, the phone card and the search result, drawn from the name, category, hours, rating and photo you type. Import an existing listing by pasting it. Download as PNG or SVG. It all happens in your browser.

entry.title: Document Scanner
entry.summary: Turn a phone photo of a page into a straightened, evenly lit PDF. The corners are found for you, the perspective is undone, the shadow is divided out. Runs entirely in your browser: nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: EXIF Viewer & Remover
entry.summary: See the EXIF and GPS data hidden in a photo, edit it, or strip the lot in one click. JPEG, PNG and WebP stay unencoded; AVIF cleaning converts to a new PNG. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: GIF Maker
entry.summary: Turn JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images into an animated GIF, free and entirely in your browser. Set the order, the speed and the size. Nothing is uploaded, and it works offline.

entry.title: HEIC to JPG
entry.summary: Convert iPhone HEIC and AVIF photos to JPG in your browser. The decoder runs on your own machine: nothing is uploaded, no account, works offline, and the date and camera details can come along. The metadata checkbox and metadata preview apply only to HEIC; AVIF metadata is always left out.

entry.title: Height Comparison Chart
entry.summary: Compare heights side by side. Add a man, a woman, a boy, a girl and objects — a door, a window, a whiteboard, a vending machine — in centimetres or feet and inches, and download the chart as a PNG or an SVG. It is drawn in your browser.

entry.title: ID Photo Maker
entry.summary: Make a passport or visa photo to your country's published rule: exact mm and DPI, a live head-height and eye-line overlay, a background check, a printable 4x6 sheet, and a file squeezed to the portal's KB limit. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Image Compressor
entry.summary: Compress a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF to an exact size - 100 KB, 2 MB, anything. Runs entirely in your browser: nothing uploaded, no account, works offline.

entry.title: Image Redactor
entry.summary: Cover a name, an address or an account number in a photo or screenshot and re-encode the picture, so the hidden pixels are gone from the file rather than sitting under a rectangle. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Image Resizer
entry.summary: Resize, crop and convert JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images in your browser. Exact pixels, a percentage, or a long edge - one image or a whole folder. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Image to Data URI
entry.summary: Turn a PNG, JPEG, SVG or WebP into a data URI you can paste into CSS or HTML. UTF-8 SVGs are percent-encoded rather than base64, so they stay readable and shorter. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Image to ICO
entry.summary: Convert a PNG, JPEG, AVIF or SVG into a real multi-size .ico or a macOS .icns in your browser. Favicon, Windows app icon, Mac app icon, plus the Apple and Android files a site needs. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Image to SVG
entry.summary: Trace a black and white image into a real SVG outline, in your browser. Logos, stencils, signatures, line art and silhouettes become curves you can scale to any size. Click to drop anything the trace got wrong. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Images to PDF
entry.summary: Combine JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images into one PDF, free and entirely in your browser. JPEG photos go in without being re-encoded, and nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Images to Video
entry.summary: Turn JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF images into an MP4 slideshow video, free and entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, no sign-up, and it works offline.

entry.title: PNG to WebP
entry.summary: Convert PNG and AVIF images to WebP in your browser, losslessly or smaller still. Transparency is kept either way. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and it works offline.

entry.title: QR & Barcode Reader
entry.summary: Read a QR code from a photo, a screenshot or your camera, and see exactly where the link goes before you open it. EAN, UPC, Code 128, Code 39 and ITF barcodes too. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: The photo your phone saved, and the format nothing will open
entry.summary: iPhones save photos as HEIC, and half the internet cannot open one. What the format is, why only Safari decodes it, what converting costs the picture, and how to do it without uploading the photos to anyone.

entry.title: The picture the web saved, and the format everything still takes
entry.summary: Saved a picture from a website and got a .webp nothing will open? What WebP is, why converting makes the file larger rather than smaller, what happens to transparency, and how to do it without uploading anything.

entry.title: The same picture, a third smaller, with the transparency intact
entry.summary: WebP is smaller than PNG even without losing anything - and far smaller if you let it. Which of the two you want depends on what is in the picture. What each mode does, what it saves, and how to convert without uploading.

entry.title: WebP to JPG
entry.summary: Convert WebP and AVIF images to JPG in your browser. Your browser already decodes WebP, so nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and it works offline. Transparency is filled with a colour you choose.

entry.title: What a photo says about you, and how to take it out
entry.summary: A photo off a phone usually carries the exact spot it was taken, the time to the second, and the camera's serial number. What is in there, who can read it, and how to take it out without touching the picture.
